description.en: The story centers on Su Bai, who utilizes the “Clock of All Things” to strengthen his skills and cultivate equipment, continuously breaking records in a global player-versus-player tower-climbing competition. The plot encompasses professional advancement, contention for “first kills,” and inter-species warfare. By clearing the dungeons on each floor of the tower, he builds his power system and unveils the world’s setting, where the “Tower of God” connects a myriad of realms. The protagonist gradually unlocks abilities such as the power of time and necromancy, driving forward the main storyline of the Blue Star (Earth) human race’s struggle for survival against higher-level civilizations.

He is obsessed with idols, crazy about idols, and would do anything for his idols. But one day, the idol he longed for turned into a demon who wants to eat him up, constantly pushing him to the edge of his sanity. Thus his agonizing and turbulent cohabitation life begins...
description.fr: Xia Yang est un étudiant très attiré par les gens avec de beaux visages, et a été fan de l'idole Jiang Zhengze pendant de nombreuses années. Il est obsédé par les idoles, fou d'eux et ferait n'importe quoi pour eux. Mais, un jour, celui dont il rêvait s'est transformé en démon voulant le dévorer, le poussant constamment dans ses retranchements. C'est ainsi que commença son angoissante et turbulente vie en cohabitation...

Su KaiJi, transmigró accidentalmente al pasado. Lo primero que paso fue que se vio a sí mismo vestido con ropa de boda, ¿acaso estaba siendo enviado al palacio para ser un consorte? En la noche de bodas, el emperador se enfrenta a la belleza que tiene delante. Y cuando vio el pecho plano debajo de la ropa, sintió que su ira aumentaba.

***If you blush, you lose!***

Living by this principle, the middle schooler Nishikata gets constantly made fun of by his seat neighbor Takagi-san. With his pride shattered to pieces, he vows to turn the tables and get back at her some day.

And so, he attempts to tease her day after day, only to find himself victim to Takagi-san's ridicule again sooner than later. Will he be able to make Takagi-san blush from embarrassment even once in the end?

description.en:
In the Xuan Sword Continent, the Way of the Sword is above all. Countless swordsmen here have paved their way to fame with their swords, and there are countless legends and myths belonging to swordsmen in this once brilliant sword world… Although the Xuan Sword Continent is no longer the same as it used to be, swordsmanship is still popular. In the Xuan Sword Continent, Xuan Sword Sect, a hardworking genius whilst in training, suddenly suffered a setback. However, the arrangement of fate granted him the Sword Tomb System. The Sword Tomb contains countless peerless famous swords from ancient and modern times, from all over the world. Starting from the moment he got his first famous sword, the young man embarks on the road of a hero who can reach the sky with one sword!
- - -
This series was put on indefinite hiatus in 2021 for lack of an editor/author.

description.en:
Zhu Xiong was reborn in a small town within Beiping territory during the early years of the Ming Dynasty.

In this significant year, Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor, was in his prime.

With Crown Prince Zhu Biao by his side, he rectified the laws and discipline of the imperial court, and consolidated the territories.

During the same period, Zhu Xiong has been living for two years with the woman he saved, Xu Jin’er. They dream of running the tavern left by his grandmother and living an ordinary life together.

However, this year takes a dramatic turn when Xu Jin’er’s family arrives, revealing that she is actually the daughter of Xu Da, a founding duke of the nation!

This revelation brings honor and unexpected challenges as the Xu family brothers seek her, bringing disgrace upon them.

Hanami Mei, who failed to die for the 501st time, clicked on a website that was rumoured to help people die. However, the path of leaving the human world was unexpected. As a result, Mei Mei and the God of Death, Tanatus, signed a contract and she became an agent of death. This is the story of Mei Mei, whose goal is to die, and the God of Death, who wishes to restore his original state.  
  
Two people with different outlooks embark on this journey of harvesting souls.  
  
Will the secrets of life and death finally be uncovered?

I am Karne Pivoine Feian, a poor and pitiful princess in hiding. Due to some unfortunate circumstances, I’m currently residing in the house of a Baroness under a hidden identity. I promised I’d do anything they asked me. But I didn’t think I’d be asked to do things that would put my life in danger! As expected, freeloading in someone else's house is no easy feat. I've got no choice. I have to find a way to reclaim my identity!

One day, a handsome man approached me to offer a deal.
"I’ll give you an unimaginably great reward if you bring me what I ask of you."

I think I've already found my reward, though! I've not only gained money, but an absolute hottie as well. Will I finally be able to walk down a path of happiness?

biography.en:
She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.
